description:
Auction comparables on ACHIEVED prices, each against our valuation.

    A portal tells you a property went to auction. This says what it MADE, and
    what our AVM thought it was worth at the same address — the difference
    between a comparable and a listing. Use it to judge whether a guide price
    is realistic, or what a lot is likely to fetch.

    `achieved_to_avm` is the hammer price as a share of our AVM. Below 1.0 the
    lot sold under the estimate; the useful spread is wide, from about 0.45 to
    0.95 within a single postcode area. Read it alongside `auction_date`: all
    AVMs share one snapshot date, so an older lot carries market movement as
    well as discount.

    Bedrooms and property type come from the UPRN-matched unit rather than the
    auction catalogue, which populates property_type on 12% of sold lots and
    tenure on none at all.

    Give `postcode_district` or `postcode_area` — auction lots carry a
    postcode, not an area_id, so there is no area_id path here.

    UK only. Free.
name: auction_comps
